entry_item.definition: v.t. and i. a) To knock down or hit in passing; to run over. b) To pass by, call or stop on the way, drop in. c) To attack with words or insult indirectly; to hit (of illness or misfortune).

example.definition: For a car or cart to hit somebody or something.
To call on the way, drop in, stop by
To pass through a village; to stop by at a neighbor's or village.
To have an attack of illness.
